description: Represents a recurrence rule that can be serialized to/from iCal RRULE format.

members.name: DayOfMonth
members.description: Day of the month for Monthly/Yearly patterns (1-31).

members.name: DaysOfWeek
members.description: Days of the week selected for Weekly pattern (0=Sunday, 6=Saturday).

members.name: EndAfter
members.description: How the recurrence ends: null = never, int = after N occurrences, DateTime = until date.

members.name: MonthOfYear
members.description: Month of the year for Yearly pattern (1-12).

members.name: Position
members.description: Position of the day in the month for Monthly (e.g. first Monday).

members.name: StartDate
members.description: The start date of the recurrence.
